findings.finding: The contract targets a demonstrated failure: a source-supported interpretation can still overstate desire, leaning, or a provisional plan as demand, decision, or commitment.
Gemini must interpret position force and preserve it in role-specific prose. The prompt states that categories are semantic descriptions, not scores or a hierarchy.
Code enforces schema vocabulary, field presence, not_applicable consistency, exact evidence custody, hashes, and terminal disposition. It does not infer, rank, compare, or score semantic force.
All 60 prompts build and all 20 reviewed fixtures compile with zero quarantine. All non-position prompts and schemas remain byte-identical to v2.
An enum-valid but source-wrong force label is admitted structurally and remains visibly wrong for source review. This is intentional evidence that no brittle semantic gate was smuggled into code.
Case-03 was selected from the two unused position candidates by ascending SHA-256 of case_id. Completed Case-01, Case-02, and Case-05 position calls were excluded before selection.
No evaluator, embedding, graph, global synthesis, runtime behavior, semantic retry, or same-case repair is introduced.

required_source_review_after_probe: starting interpretation preserves a stated view rather than inventing demand decision or commitment
current interpretation preserves the explicitly provisional plan and deferred decision
qualification preserves possibility and the open partnership question
trajectory explains movement without force inflation or invented totality
every admitted claim is checked against cited source text
nonclaims: Provider-free conformance is not model-behavior evidence.
One fresh position probe cannot establish stability, transfer, product value, receipt quality, or trust.
Categorical labels do not create a quality score or prove semantic correctness.
The reviewed fixtures are same-session development references, not independent gold.
